info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Portfolio Retrieval API
info.description: The Customer Portfolio Retrieval API allows users to access specific portfolio details for a given customer. By providing the customer ID and portfolio ID, clients can retrieve essential information about the customer's financial assets, investment strategies, and overall portfolio performance. This API is particularly useful for financial analysts, customer support teams, and application developers who need to integrate portfolio data into their services or tools. It enables organizations to enhance customer engagement by offering tailored insights based on individual portfolio characteristics.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific portfolio for a customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the detailed information about a specific portfolio belonging to a customer identified by their unique ID. You can use this to review portfolio performance or details associated with the customer.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the specific portfolio details for the customer identified by CUST-100045 and portfolio RES-100045. It includes all necessary parameters required to process the request.

200.description: The request was successful, and the portfolio data is returned.
